# exo_arc_config (Data Source)

Look up an existing ArcConfig object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `arc_trusted_sealers` (Set of String) Maps to the -ArcTrustedSealers parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
